heading: Efficacy and safety versus warfarin (ROCKET AF)
text: In the intention-to-treat analysis, the primary end point occurred in 269 rivaroxaban patients (2.1% per year) and 306 warfarin patients (2.4% per year) (hazard ratio 0.88; 95% CI, 0.74 to 1.03; P<0.001 for noninferiority; P=0.12 for superiority).

evidence.quote: In the intention-to-treat analysis, the primary end point occurred in 269 patients in the rivaroxaban group (2.1% per year) and 306 patients in the warfarin group (2.4% per year) (hazard ratio, 0.88; 95% CI, 0.74 to 1.03; P<0.001 for noninferiority; P=0.12 for superiority).
